description: Defines the HpackStringDecoder class for decoding HPACK-encoded strings in HTTP/2 headers, including methods for starting and resuming decoding, handling Huffman encoding, and callbacks for string data.

classes.name: HpackStringDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding HPACK-encoded strings in HTTP/2 headers, managing state for length decoding, Huffman encoding, and string data callbacks.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a string from the buffer, handling short strings directly or setting up for longer strings.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding based on current state, handling length decoding and string data.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state.

methods.name: StartDecodingLength
methods.description: Decodes the length of the string, handling partial data across buffers.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingLength
methods.description: Continues decoding the length if it was split across buffers.

methods.name: OnStringStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when string decoding starts, providing Huffman encoding info and length.

methods.name: DecodeString
methods.description: Decodes and passes string data to the listener, signaling end when complete.
